events.title: Battle of Clontarf
events.description: Irish High King Brian Boru led his forces to victory over a Viking and Leinster alliance near Dublin. Brian, by then an old man, was killed in the fighting.
events.significance: Brian Boru became one of Ireland's best-remembered heroes. The battle weakened Viking power in Ireland, and it remains a defining story in Irish history.

events.title: Order of the Garter Announced
events.description: On St George's Day, King Edward III of England announced the founding of the Order of the Garter. It was a new order of chivalry for a small circle of loyal knights.
events.significance: It is still the highest order of chivalry in England. It has lasted more than 650 years.

events.title: The Merry Wives of Windsor Premieres
events.description: Shakespeare's comedy was performed for the first time, with Queen Elizabeth I in the audience. The play follows the comic misadventures of the boastful knight Sir John Falstaff.
events.significance: It is one of Shakespeare's liveliest comedies and shows how closely his work was tied to the royal court.

events.title: Greek Government Evacuates Athens
events.description: As German forces advanced during World War II, King George II and the Greek government left Athens. The Wehrmacht was invading the country.
events.significance: The evacuation marked the collapse of organized Greek resistance on the mainland. It was followed by years of Axis occupation.

events.title: First YouTube Video Uploaded
events.description: Co-founder Jawed Karim uploaded "Me at the zoo", a clip of about 19 seconds. It was the first video ever posted to the platform.
events.significance: This short clip marked the start of a platform that changed how the world makes, shares and watches video.
